Frequently Asked Questions

What tents can I rent in Fall River?
Two options: a 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent ($100 self-serve, $150 with setup and takedown, weight bags included) and a 20x20 Pole Tent ($300 self-serve, $400 with setup and takedown, stakes and guy ropes on grass). Both are open-sided canopy tents available for Fall River events.
What does tent delivery to Fall River cost?
Travel from Bridgewater is $0.72/km after the first free 15 km and is confirmed in your quote. Availability, setup suitability, and final delivery pricing for Fall River are confirmed manually before booking.
Are these enclosed event tents?
No. Both the 10x10 and 20x20 are open-sided shade canopies, not enclosed event tents. They must stay anchored at all times and cannot be used in high winds, storms, unsafe weather, or on unsuitable surfaces.
Is self-serve tent rental available in Fall River?
Yes. Self-serve means you set the tent up and take it down yourself — $100 for the 10x10 and $300 for the 20x20. Prefer hands-off? Our team handles setup and takedown for $150 (10x10) or $400 (20x20) at Fall River bookings, subject to scheduling.
